title: Oxidation states of transition metals
basic_overview: Variable oxidation states arise from comparable ns and d energies plus ligand/environment stabilisation.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Find oxidation state → d count → ligand/environment.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Assign OS. 2. Count d. 3. Check ligand character. 4. Consider redox stability.
extra_info_content.factors: High oxidation states often favour O/F donors; lower states can be stabilised by softer ligands.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
